title: BuildAIMaker runtime-pins
description: L2 integrity pins for managed Python: lockfile hash, interpreter path, entry module hashes. TeamID is never applied to venv/CPython.

version.description: Schema version of this pin file.

appVersion.description: App version that owns this managed env (maps to envs/python/<appVersion>/).

sizeBudgetBytes.description: Upper bound for progress UI / install guardrails (bytes).

relativePath.description: Path relative to the Workers/python pins root.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the lockfile bytes.

interpreterRelativePath.description: Interpreter path relative to the managed env root (e.g. bin/python3).

relativePath.description: Path relative to the Workers/python pins root.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the entry module bytes.
